The '''Aaeton system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in space controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Aaeton system also had representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
